about_the_game:
Game Overview:
In the aftermath of the god Corydon Deus’s mysterious disappearance, the world of Reditus has been plunged into a spiritual and magical void. The faithful have been exiled to the Heremus—a harsh and barren wasteland—by the technologically dominant Reditus, a futuristic civilization that has outlawed religion and magic.

You play as Augustus, a steadfast believer in Corydon Deus, and his son Caeser, a skeptic yearning for a better future for himself and his betrothed, Theresa. Together, they journey through the Heremus in search of the lost city of Vehere, facing both environmental and ideological threats in their quest to restore magic to the world.

Core Mechanics:

  • Exploration & Quests: Traverse a semi-open world filled with lore-rich NPCs, branching side quests, and narrative-driven objectives that shape your party’s development and worldview.

  • Strategic Turn-Based Combat: Battles feature a dynamic turn-based system that emphasizes exploiting enemy weaknesses. Successfully targeting weaknesses will stagger foes, opening them up for high-damage follow-up attacks via the AMP (Assault Momentum Protocol) system.

  • Quick Time Events (QTEs): Combat is further enhanced with QTEs, where precise timing allows players to parry incoming strikes, land critical hits, or activate combat bonuses during key moments.

  • Overdrives: As characters take damage, their Overdrive meter fills. Once full, they can unleash powerful, character-specific special attacks that can shift the tide of battle—perfect for high-stakes encounters and boss fights.

  • Character Progression: Players level up, equip new gear, and unlock unique abilities that reflect the characters’ personal growth and philosophical alignment—faith, doubt, or something in between.

Other Notable Key Features:

Fast paced turn-based battles

No random encounters; enemies can be seen running around

Tons of items to be looted, stolen or crafted

16-bit SNES style sprites and 3D models

Music inspired by PSX RPGs

60-70 Hrs gameplay

Collect Robots and have them battle in an Arena

Multi Party Tactical Battles

Tons of Mini Games

short_description: Reditus is a richly crafted 2.5D JRPG that fuses retro-inspired pixel art with modern 3D environments. Set in a mystical world where magic has vanished, the game follows a father-son duo on a dangerous pilgrimage to restore lost divine power.
